nodes.name: FreeBusy
nodes.notes: Booked Slots output: one item per busy interval, {start, end} as UTC ISO strings (Z); no busy interval gives no item, so alwaysOutputData emits one empty {} item. A failed calendar call must fail the tool: slots offered without the calendar would be wrong.

parameters.timeMin: ={{ (() => { const z = $('Settings').first().json.fields.timezone; const d = DateTime.fromISO(String($('Trigger').first().json.date || '').trim(), { zone: z }); return (d.isValid ? d : DateTime.now().setZone(z)).startOf('day').toISO(); })() }}
parameters.timeMax: ={{ (() => { const z = $('Settings').first().json.fields.timezone; const d = DateTime.fromISO(String($('Trigger').first().json.date || '').trim(), { zone: z }); return (d.isValid ? d : DateTime.now().setZone(z)).startOf('day').plus({ days: 8 }).toISO(); })() }}
